security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'

bundle.shortDescription: High-performance media converter powered by FFmpeg.
bundle.longDescription: Kenichi Converter is a sleek, native desktop app for converting video and audio files. Powered by FFmpeg and built with Tauri v2, it offers format conversion, resolution control, trimming, GIF export, and smart compression — all with a beautiful Pro Gray interface.
